The transaction contains critical deadline inconsistencies, most notably conflicting Closing Dates between the Share Purchase Agreement (19 August 2026) and Escrow Agreement (24 June 2026), creating immediate execution risk. Regulatory clearance is expected after the Escrow Agreement's purported Closing Date, potentially jeopardising the escrow arrangement.
